messages:
Maya: thinking out loud — proposal for multi-phase warmup + throttle + tenant opt-out for the routing-change rollout. goal: safe perf-first ramp for the new dynamic routing policy without surprising customers. please weigh in with hard blockers and concrete numbers.
Sam: +1. can we define phases as: internal canary (team), pilot (3 customers), regional ramp (10% -> 50%), global? each phase = 48h stable window by default.
Li: agree on phases. two technical asks: 1) TTL-based flag decay, 2) an emergency backstop that forces model variant -> v1 and disables routing. rough flag config below.
Li: ```json
{
  "flag": "dynamic-routing",
  "phases": ["internal","pilot","regional","global"],
  "decay_seconds": 1209600, // 14 days
  "kill_switch": "/api/admin/flags/dynamic-routing/disable"
}
```
TJ: experiment/metrics note: we need A/B buckets with 1) per-request latency p95, 2) user-visible error rate, 3) generation-quality regressions (BLEU-ish / custom eval), 4) cost delta. Minimum sample: 100k requests per bucket or 72h, whichever first.
Zara: ops/customer ask: pilot customers must have an explicit opt-out URL and a two-week rollback SLA in contract notes. also please add a customer-visible banner for the pilot cohort (opt-in language).
Maya: gating criteria I'm proposing (short):
- p95 latency delta vs baseline <= +20ms
- error rate delta <= 0.25% absolute
- token-cost delta <= +3%
- no P1/P0 tickets from pilot cohort in 48h
If any gate trips, roll back to v1 and pause ramp.
Sam: backstop plan: automatic fallback if regional p95 > gate OR regional CPU/GPU saturation > 80% for >= 10m. fallback = route to compatible model variant on Dedicated pool, mark flag as degraded. also add a short-circuit that reduces concurrency-per-tenant by 50%.
Maya: runbook snippet for oncall (very short):
- alert fires -> oncall ack -> if metric breach, hit kill-switch -> post-mortem + customer comms within 6h.
deploy-bot: :rocket: scheduled rollout job created by @Maya for Monday 09:00 UTC. job id: job-9876.
Li: technical detail: prefix caching + KV reuse can make warmup noisy. recommend staging cache-warmup step: shadow traffic to new routing for 6h before switching any live traffic (no serving, just cache population).
TJ: A/B details: keep experiment flags stable per-tenant (not per-request). randomize at tenant level. metric windows: 15m, 1h, 6h, 48h. alert thresholds at 15m and 1h for fast rollback.
Zara: communication: I can draft pilot emails + dashboard snippet for customers. propose pilot start Mon -> 2 customers day1, add a 3rd after 24h if green.
Sam: chaos note: we should run a short simulated capacity spike during internal canary. oncall will standby.
Maya: follow-ups / owners:
- Li: implement flag TTL + kill-switch endpoint (JIRA: INF-2319)
- Sam: backstop routing + concurrency throttle (JIRA: INF-2320)
- TJ: experiment plan + metric deck (JIRA: EXP-456)
- Zara: customer comms + opt-out page (JIRA: CS-102)
I'll own rollout coordination and gating. target pilot = next Mon.
Li: minor: suggest auto-decay logs and a dashboard for flags expiring so we don't lose track.
TJ: also add a synthetic traffic probe that mimics large prompt sizes — we care about tail p95.
Zara: noted. I'll schedule a short pilot kickoff with the two customers and send the comms draft tomorrow.
Sam: 👍. I'll prepare a quick A/B kill-script we can run from oncall console.
Maya: thanks everyone. if no major objections by EOD I'll lock the plan and create the final rollout checklist.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: job-9876 created and awaiting manual start.
